## Contract and data impact

- [ ] No contract or migration change.
- [ ] Updated `contracts/` and compatibility evidence is included.
- [ ] Added a forward migration; no applied migration was edited.
- [ ] RLS, tenant/workspace scope, and authorization were reviewed.

## Security and execution boundaries

- [ ] No secret, `.env`, build artifact, or local database was added.
- [ ] Model, Skill, MCP, and UI input remain untrusted data.
- [ ] All side effects continue through the Tool Gateway.
- [ ] High-impact actions remain bound to trusted approval and canonical `action_hash`.
- [ ] Idempotency and ambiguous external-write handling were considered.
